mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate above 2% in the last quarter but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy, which typically suppresses economic growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS occurs but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average, it indicates a supply shock that typically leads to higher inflation and tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 12-month moving average but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 4.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signal a weakening housing sector, a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST below 1300.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which drives corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5%) typically triggers a restrictive monetary policy stance, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 3.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.
